Commentary.Commentary: Right, then! That's it from us. England have gotten off to a winning start in this tournament and flaunted their dominance over the Bangladeshis. We had a good game today, and we have another one for you tomorrow. It's a big one as Australia take on New Zealand at Edgbaston at 1030 local (0930 GMT). Do join us for it. Till then, cheers!

Eoin Morgan says when the guys bat like that it's easier to chase down big targets. Applauds Joe Root and Alex Hales who played magnificently well. Credits Root and mentions that he has scored a lot of runs in the last couple of years and he continues to do that. Adds he wants to lead from the front in this tournament and highlights it's important to start well, which is what they've done. After 25 overs, thought his team controlled and minimized the damage and as a result, the game never got taken away from them, which is a credit to the bowlers. (On Adil Rashid) Says they did not miss him, which is a testament to his players. States Chris Woakes is the biggest concern and he'll have a scan later, Root has a niggle so they'll assess everything later. Ends by saying they'll be keeping an eye on the Australia-New Zealand game tomorrow.

Mashrafe Mortaza says that it was a good total but on this wicket it was a touch short. Adds that in the middle overs, they couldn't get the wickets and applauds Joe Root for his performance. Mentions that it's fine when the new batsmen take time to settle in but at the death, they should have added some more runs. Informs that the main bowlers need to step up and they might have some thinking to do ahead of the next match on playing an extra bowler. On Morgan's catch by Iqbal, he feels that the third umpire knows better and his decision is the final one.

Man of the Match, Joe Root says that there's a lot of confidence in the dressing room. Adds that they never doubted themselves to chase this total down. Mentions that wickets in hand was the key and wanted one of the top four to play through. Informs that the ankle is alright but it's more of a calf issue and hopes that it's just a bad cramp.

Bangladesh had a decent score on the board to begin with. Their bowlers would have had to come up with something special to get something out of this game but the comfortable asking rate didn't put any kind of pressure on the English batsmen and they took their time to cruise along to victory. Plenty to ponder for them, need to regroup fast as this tournament doesn't offer much time.

Can't say it wasn't expected. England do possess one of the strongest batting line-ups in the world and they showed that today. 306 wasn't that hard but not that simple either. Jason Roy departed early but then the next two partnerships finished things off. Hales and Root with a 159-run stand, then Root and Morgan with an unbeaten partnership of 143. Root went on to score a ton while the other two made stunning fifties, with Hales just missing out on a ton by 5 runs.

FOUR! Root wins it in style! Fuller delivery around off, Root kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary. England create history as they become the first team to chase a total in excess of 300 in the Champions Trophy. THEY WIN BY 8 WICKETS!
FOUR! Full on the stumps, Root dances down and whips it over mid-wicket. The ball lands just before the fence before crossing it. This is Root's highest ever ODI score. Just 2 needed now!
Mosaddek Hossain back into the attack.
Full around off, Morgan lofts it inside out over covers for a brace. Just 6 needed now!

In the air... but safe! Back of a length delivery, angling in. Root goes for the pull but seems to be early in his shot. Ends up top edging it. Mustafizur Rahman at short fine leg, rushes to the square leg region but fails to reach the ball and it lands safely. This is the first mistimed shot from Root in the whole innings. A single is taken!
Yorker around off, squeezed to point for a single.
Short delivery, Root pulls it firmly to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! In the air... but in the gap! Full outside off, Root slices it over covers. There's a huge gap there and the ball races to the fence. They are in a hurry to chase this total down quickly.
Very full on middle, Morgan jams it out to mid off for a single.

FOUR! Good end to the over for England! Full outside off, slanting away from Root. He shifts his weight onto the front foot and drives it crisply through covers. The man in the deep there, dives to his right to cut it off but fails. 16 runs off the over! 16 needed off 24 now!
Cutter on a length outside off, Morgan waits for it and punches it through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Full toss outside off, Morgan creams his drive through covers for a boundary. He moves to 70 off just 57 deliveries!
SIX! In the arc of Morgan and he clobbers it over mid-wicket. It's the shorter part of the ground and the ball sails into the stands for a maximum.
Rahman bowls an excellent yorker on middle, Morgan does well to keep it out. He couldn't have done much there.
Slower delivery, eased down to long off for a single.
Very full around leg, Eoin digs it out to mid-wicket. 32 needed off 30!
Yorker outside off, Morgan makes room but only manages to squeeze it out to point.
Length delivery outside off, cut hard past backward point for a single.
FOUR! Full toss on middle, Root whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. It's a glorious shot!
A yorker around off, jammed out back to the bowler.
100-run stand between Root and Morgan!
SIX! Root with his first maximum! A touch ahead on a length around off, Root waits for it and clubs it over long on for a biggie. He is on the move as well now.
Change of ends for Rubel Hossain!
Low full toss, Morgan looks to smoke it straight down the ground but mistimes it over mid off. By the time the long on fielder gets to the ball, the batsmen complete a couple.
Full on middle, drilled hard to mid on. The fielder there half-stops it and concedes a single.
Back of a length cutter, Morgan works it to fine leg for a single.
Wide yorker, squeezed out to backward point.
Almost a yorker on middle and off, Morgan digs it out to mid on.
Shortish delivery, angling in, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Angling in from around off, Root plays it in the mid-wicket region for a single.
10th ODI ton for Joe Root!

ROOOOOOOOOOT! That's what the whole of Oval is humming. Fuller on the pads, Root clips it through backward square leg. There's a big gap there and Joe comes back for the second. Completes it with ease and that's his century. What a knock, what a player! This is a well-deserved century for the English run-machine.
Another slower one around leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower one, dabbed in the point region.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Length delivery, angling away, Morgan looks to glide it away on the off side but gets an outside edge past short third man for a boundary.
33rd ODI fifty for Eoin Morgan!
FOUR! Boundary off the first ball! Full outside off, Morgan takes a stride forward and carves it past point for a boundary. Gets to his fifty with that. Another captain's knock from him!
Change of ends for Mashrafe Mortaza!
Very full on middle, driven to long on for a single.
That kept low! Slanting away from the southpaw. Morgan looks to play with an angled bat but misses.
Morgan dances down and dabs the length delivery to backward point.
Pitched outside off, pushed in the cover region. A fumble there allows the batsmen to complete a single.
Back of a length delivery around off, Root looks to pull but the ball goes under his bat.
Length delivery, flicked to mid-wicket. The fielder there, dives but ends up parrying it to mid on. Dot ball!
Rubel Hossain is into the attack!
Full in the line of the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, placed in the gap in covers for a single.
Full on middle and leg, knocked down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Morgan seems to be in a hurry! Flatter and slightly shorter, Morgan cuts it firmly through point for a boundary. 64 needed off 57 now!
SIX! That's huge! Shakib bowls it quicker through the air around middle, Morgan dances down the track and clobbers it over long on for a maximum. That is some hit!
Full outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on!
Powerplay 3 has been signalled! Now, a maximum of 5 players can be placed outside the inner ring.
Slants across a length ball, Morgan punches it straight back and hits the stumps at the other end. England need 75 to win off 60 deliveries.
With the keeper right up to the stumps, Mortaza spears in a yorker on middle. Eoin Morgan does well to dig it out back to the bowler.
Angling back in on the pads, Root flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery just around off, Joe hangs back and pushes it on the off side.
Fuller in length and pitched around off, driven to mid off by Root.
FOUR! Exquisite timing. Didn't try to overhit it. With excellent balance and a beautiful swing of his bat, Joe Root drives it through the covers for a boundary. No chance of stopping that one.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

A direct hit this time and Joe Root would have been out of here. Similar stuff to what happened in the previous delivery. Mosaddek throws but doesn't hit the stumps at the striker's end this time. Single completed.

Back of a length outside off, Morgan opens the face of the bat and taps it down towards third man. Mosaddek from backward point runs to his right and cuts it off. Has a shy at the striker's end, gets a direct hit but the batsmen is well in by then. The batsmen take an extra run for the overthrow.
Full on middle and off, kept out in front of covers.
Harmless length delivery in the off stump channel, Joe Root cuts it through to sweeper cover for an easy run.
Angles in a length ball from around the wicket, Root covers the line and taps it down on the off side with soft hands.
Mustafizur Rahman replaces Shakib!
Full on the stumps, driven back down the ground. One run added to the scoreboard.
Stays behind the line of this one and defends it from within his crease.
Fullish outside off, driven through covers for a single.
FOUR! Slower length ball on middle, Eoin Morgan shuffles across a bit and plays the pick up shot over backward square leg for a boundary. Such a fine shot, he's a lovely player to watch.
From around the wicket, Morgan looks to run it down to third man but is beaten. The keeper is up to the stumps so the southpaw can't venture out of his crease and do anything.
50-run stand up between Morgan and Root!
Back of a length into the body, Root swivels a bit and pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Angling in from around off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide called.
Well adjusted. Morgan was looking to play the reverse sweep but seeing the line going down leg, scoops it fine down the leg side past the keeper for a couple of runs.
Coming in with the angle, Joe uses that well and clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Coming into him, worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Quicker one on leg stump, Eoin goes back and works it to backward square leg for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Sliding in on the pads, worked wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.

Not out! Eoin Morgan survives! Lucky break for the England skipper. The left-hander leans ahead and lofts it towards long on. Tamim Iqbal there runs in from the deep and dives forward to take it. He is very sure that he has taken the catch cleanly. But the umpire decides to take it to the TV umpire. The soft signal is not out to which Tamim Iqbal reacts. The replays are not conclusive, so the soft signal will stand. Tamim is not at all happy, walks up to the umpire and tries to convince him that he really did take it. Won't matter now though, mate. Gotta carry on. Single taken.
The umpire has gone upstairs to check if the catch of Eoin Morgan taken by Tamim Iqbal is clean or not. The soft signal is not out.
Angling in on leg, catches Eoin on the pads. Was always sliding down leg.
Bit ahead of a length, around off, pushed away from the body to mid off.
Starts off from around the wicket, it's angling in from around off on a length, Morgan pushes it to the covers.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.
Over the wicket for the last ball of the over, eased back down to long on for a run.
Full and straight, Root with a big lunge forward drives it through the gap in the covers for one.

Sliding in with the arm on middle and leg, Root picks it off his pads and flicks it through mid-wicket. Is struggling to run with that twisted ankle but still manages to come back for the second comfortably.
From around the wicket, darted full outside off, Joe drives it square to point for nothing.
Gets back to this quicker delivery and offers a firm punch to long on for a single. 200 is up for England.
Pushed quicker through the air, fuller on off, Morgan goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan is back into the attack!
Shorter around off, Morgan with a back foot punch through to sweeper cover for one.
Full toss, gets low to this one and sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Over the wicket now, it's flighted outside off, driven through the covers again. Root will pick up a couple of runs for doing so.
Extremely loopy on middle and off, Morgan makes room and drives it through the covers for a single.
Gives it a decent amount of flight and tosses it up on the stumps, Morgan plays it back to the bowler.
FOUR! From around the wicket, flat and short around off, Eoin Morgan rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket. It falls just inside the rope and goes across on one bounce.
Drinks have been taken! England are cruising at the moment. Unless Bangladesh can scalp wickets in quick succession, the Englishmen will win comfortably.
Fuller delivery outside off, Morgan pushes it past the non-striker for a single.
Morgan dances down the wicket, drives it on the bounce back to the bowler. Rubel grabs the ball and mimes a throw back. Seeing that, Morgan rushes back to his crease.
Fullish delivery, Morgan prods forward and pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Shortish delivery, angling away, Morgan mistimes his pull slightly. The ball bounces in front of mid on, who dives across, gets fingertips on it but can't prevent it from reaching the fence.
Slightly ahead of length outside off. Root plays a punchy drive through covers for a single.
Length delivery around off, played across the line to mid-wicket.
Spinning into the batsman, played off the back foot to long on for a single.
Sliding away from the southpaw, cut to sweeper cover for a single.
Spinning in from around off, Root goes back and punches it through wide mid on for a single.
Full outside off, Morgan lofts it inside out over covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Root dances down, Hossain fires it in. Root does well to knock it through mid on for a single.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, driven past bowler but to mid on.
On a length outside off, Root prods ahead and taps it in covers and takes off for a quick single. There's a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Fuller one on middle and leg, timely driven to mid on.
Similar delivery and Root once again taps it to point.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point.
Full outside off, driven to deep point for a single.
Rubel Hossain is brought back into the attack.
Darted in full on off, flicked to short mid-wicket. England need 129 off 120 balls!
Quicker through the air, pushed in the cover region.
Full on middle and off, spinning in a touch, driven back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery outside off, Morgan punches it off the back foot through cover-point for a single.
Served outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
FOUR! Easy! Straighter, flatter delivery outside off, Root goes back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary. He played that so smoothly.
Mosaddek Hossain to bowl once more.
Length delivery, angling away, punched on the off side. The extra cover fielder fails to stop it but mid off covers him. No run taken.
Length delivery, angling in, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly ahead of length outside off, driven on the up to mid off.
Morgan punches it off the back foot through mid off for a single.
FOUR! Streaky! Fuller length around off, angling away. Morgan looks to drive but gets an outside edge and the ball races to the third man fence. He is off the mark!
Back of a length delivery, punched to covers.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.
Eoin Morgan is the new man in.

OUT! He's gone! Oh, dear... He's missed out on his century here. What a rash shot to play, fallen just 5 short of the milestone. He goes for the big slog sweep and doesn't middle it. Finds Sunzamul Islam (sub) out at deep mid-wicket who runs to his right and takes a good, tumbling catch. Partnership of 159 is broken. Bangladesh desperately needed this wicket. Could this be their chance to inflict further damage?
SIX! BANG! That's outta here! Alex Hales, you beauty! Walks down the track and heaves it across the line to clear the wide long on boundary for a maximum.
FOUR! Half-tracker which Hales sees it well early. Rocks back and pulls it past wide long on for a boundary.
On the shorter side of things, outside off, Root off the outer half plays it down to third man for a single.
On the shorter side, it's slapped back down the ground off the back foot for a run.
Flat, short and outside off, cut away through to sweeper cover for an easy run.
Sabbir Rahman comes on to bowl.
Length delivery outside off, cut away through cover-point for a single.
Good length delivery around off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Going across once more, just around off, run down to third man with an open face for one.
Bit fullish in length and slower in pace, Alex Hales lofts it over the wide mid on fielder. It's chased down and kept just inside the rope, the batsmen take two.
Full and fired just outside off, Hales drives it to the right of the bowler, who does well to get low and stop it in his followthrough.
Slanting across the England No.3, he hangs back and plays it late to third man for a single.
FOUR! This time over the infield! Full outside off, Hales dances down and lofts it over wide mid off for a boundary. Good option, this!
Full outside off, driven hard but straight to mid off.
Length delivery, dabbed towards short third man region for a single.

Banged in short outside off, Root pulls it over mid-wicket. Sabbir in the deep, hares to his left and stops it before the fence. A brace is taken. The replays show that Root twisted his ankle as he played that shot and as a result he was limping across.
Full outside off, Hales mistimes his drive through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Root waits for it and glides it to third man for a single.
Full on off, Root gently places it in the cover region and takes off for a single. 168 needed of 150 balls!
On a length around leg, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slanting away from Hales, who dances down the track and goes for a big shot but misses.
Length delivery outside off, placed to point.
Full outside off, Hales gets across and clips it to mid on.
Full outside off, driven off the front foot through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Hales dances down the track and ends up mistiming his pull to mid on.
Banged in short, Hales goes for the pull but it's too quick for him and ends up missing it.
Length delivery outside off, chopped to backward point.
Fullish outside off, steered to backward point.
Short delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Hales pushes it towards mid off and takes off for a quick single. The throw at the bowler's end misses and a single is completed.
Rubel Hossain returns.
Angling away from Root, steered to point.
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side. Root is quick between the wickets and takes a brace. England are ticking along nicely.

On a length and angling away, Hales taps it towards backward point. Root from the other end takes off and completes a quick single. Seeing Hales slow to take off, there's a throw at the bowler's end but to now avail.
Length delivery, angling away, dabbed to third man for a single.
Full and slanting away, Root drives it crisply through covers for a brace.

Another leading edge but safe again! Cutter on leg, Hales looks to play it across the line but gets a leading edge. The ball is in air for a while but falls in the gap between extra cover and mid off. A single is taken.
22nd ODI fifty for Joe Root!
Slanting into the batsman, Root works it through mid-wicket for a brace. Fifty for Root. You can always depend on this guy for delivering for his side.
Slightly slower through the air outside off, milked down to long off for a single.
SIX! Into the stands! Served outside off, Hales dances down the track and tonks it over long off for a maximum. He is on the move now!
FOUR! Swept away! Full in the line of the stumps, Hales kneels down and sweeps it powerfully through backward square leg for a boundary.
Skidding into the batsman, Root flicks it off the front foot in front of square on the leg side. Completes a single and then looks for a second but is sent back.
Sliding into the batsman, punched down to long on for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan is back into the attack.
Beaten! Full and slanting away from Root, who looks to drive but misses. Good over this from the Fizz!

Shout for lbw! A cutter at 98 kph around leg. Root looks to defend from within the crease but misses it completely. Gets rapped on his thigh and the bowler starts appealing. The umpire however turns it down. Mustafizur looks at his skipper for the review but they don't go for it. The replays show that it pitched outside leg.
Full outside off, Root looks to drive off the front foot but mistimes it towards mid off.
Cutter on leg, defended neatly by Root.
Slanting across Root, who looks to push it with the angle but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Squared up! Cutter on middle and leg, Hales looks to play across the line but is early into the shot. Gets a leading edge which falls safely in the cover region. A single is taken.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack!
Hales does the same as his partner as he eases it through mid on. Single to end the over.
Loopy full delivery on the stumps, driven easily down to long on for a run.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched away to covers.
Pitched right up there, easy enough for the batsman to place it through the big gap in the vacant mid-wicket area for one.
A lot of flight on this occasion, Root leans ahead and drives it through the covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, comfortably flicked through mid-wicket for one run. The 100-run stand is up as well.
Length delivery on off which is driven towards mid off for a brisk run.
FOUR! That's an even better shot considering he had very little room to play. Waits for it, uses the pace and places the cut past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Skids off the deck again, outside off, Root fails to put bat on ball.

FOUR! Magnificent! If Joe Root wasn't a cricketer, pretty sure he'd be a killer race car driver as he picks the gaps so well. Fuller delivery angling in, Root flicks it between mid on and mid-wicket. The timing was so good it left the chasing fielder with no chance of stopping it. Super shot.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the covers.
Drinks break!
It's a little too full to sweep but Root still manages to get it away. Places it in front of square on the leg side and as a result, will keep strike.
Floats it up outside off, Alex with a gentle push to the covers for a comfortable run.
Slider going down leg, the English opener gets down to sweep but it goes off his pads down towards fine leg. Two leg byes are taken.
Mosaddek gives it some more air, tosses it up on middle and leg, Hales gets an inside edge onto his pads as he looks to flick.
Some decent flight on this occasion, Root kneels down and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flat and quicker through the air, Joe pushes it back to the bowler.
9th ODI fifty for Alex Hales!

FOUR! Oh, wow... He's really got a hold of that, hasn't he? Cracking shot. Back of a length and Hales picks up the length early. He heaves it over mid-wicket and sends it across the rope. Brings up his fifty with that shot too, solid knock so far from the opener.
Stays right behind the line and defends well.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Too straight again, off the inner half Alex tucks it through backward square leg for a run.
Errs slightly in line, Root moves across a touch before he flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length delivery outside off, skids off the surface and beats the outside edge of Joe Root's bat, who is looking to cut.
This time Hales finds the gap in the mid-wicket region. Two more runs to end the over.
Joe Root flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Root makes use of his feet, gets close to the pitch and flicks it through to deep mid-wicket for two.
Keeps it full and on the stumps, driven to mid on. Dot ball.
Wide! Darts it down the leg side, Root kneels down to sweep it fine down the leg side but misses. Wide called by the umpire.
On the pads once more, worked away to backward square leg for one.
Turning in and going down leg, raps Hales on the pads who looks to flick it across the line. Half-hearted appeal from the bowler, nothing from the umpire.
Hales opens the face of the bat to this length ball outside off and runs it down to third man for a run.
Outside off on a length, played to point.
Slightly ahead of a length, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish in length, driven to mid on.
Wide outside off, on a length, not quite short enough to cut but Root still manages to get it away. Places it square through point for a couple of runs.
Back of a length outside off, Hales rocks back and presents a solid punch through backward point for a single.
Rubel Hossain to have a go with the ball.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Worked away to the mid-wicket region for no run.
Outside off on a length, hit to short third man.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Similar ball, Hales offers a back foot punch as well. Beats the diving short mid-wicket fielder who gets a hand to it only to parry it to long on. Single taken.
Drops it just back of a driving length and it's spinning in, Root goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain is brought into the attack.
Short again and Hales offers a back foot punch to covers.
Shorter and flatter outside the line of off stump, Hales attempts to cut but fails to do so.
Darted on leg, worked off the pads through square leg for a run.

FOUR! Bowl him there and he will punish you all day long. On the pads, angling down further, Root just tickles it fine down the leg side. Beats short fine leg and sends it across the rope for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, cut away straight to the point fielder.
FOUR! Too straight in line, on middle stump and Root plays it away really well. Just times it extremely well as he punches it through the mid-wicket area for a boundary.
On the pads, glanced down to fine leg for a single and that will be the end of the over.
Full ball on off, Hales turns it to the right of mid on. The fielder there runs to his right and makes an excellent diving stop. Saves a certain boundary with that effort. Just a single taken.
Cutter going across the batsman, Hales eases it away to the covers. Is unfortunate that it went straight to the fielder.
Takes a little pace off this, it's pushed down to mid off by the batsman.
50-run stand between Hales and Root!
Good length ball outside off, Root leans ahead and pushes it through cover-point and takes one.
Slanting across on a back of a length, Joe Root from within his crease defends it down on the off side.
On the stumps, Root punches it down to long on for one.
Shorter in length once again, around off, Root checks his cut shot at the last second. Wasn't exactly in control of that as he hit it to the covers.
Back of a length on off, Hales goes back and punches it through the covers for a run.
Seaming in off the deck, flicked to short fine leg. No run taken.
Shortish ball, punched down to long on for a single.
Length delivery on off, Hales drives it back down the ground for a single.
Soumya Sarkar is into the attack.
Powerplay 2 is signalled! From now on, maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the inner ring till the 40th over.
Fullish outside off, Root checks his drive to covers.
Length delivery, driven off the inner half towards long on for a single.
Length delivery, punched on the up to covers.
Fuller around off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Slanting away from Hales, punched on the up through cover-point for a boundary. That's a confident shot.
Cutter, dabbed behind point for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is introduced into the attack.

FOUR! Misfield! Full on off, Hales hits it past the bowler. Fails to connect it cleanly but beats mid off. Tamim from long on, hares to his left, puts in a dive but fails to sweep the ball in. The ball crosses the ropes and a boundary is signaled.
Length delivery, angling in, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length and angling in, punched down to long on for a single.
Length delivery outside off, punched on the up to covers.
Angling into the batsman, played with the angle to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery, glided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Full on middle and off, Hales clears his front leg and slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 8 runs off the over!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Served full outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.

Full on middle, Root drives it straight down. Shakib, gets low to his right, looks to deflect it onto the stumps but fails. The ball runs behind and a single is taken. The replays show that had the ball hit, Hales was a goner!
Full on off, Hales drives it straight back. Shakib misfields and concedes a single.
Sliding into the batsman, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Pitched outside off, Root glides is behind square on the off side. The fielder there, makes a good sliding stop.
Slightly behind length outside off, Root punches it through the gap in covers. The ball doesn't reach the fence and a couple is taken.
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Back of a length delivery, Root gets on his toes and punches it to cover-point.
Short delivery, Hales pulls it firmly through backward square leg. The fielder in the deep, runs to his right and makes a good sliding stop. A single is taken.
Back of a length delivery, defended in front of covers.
Served outside off, dabbed to point.
Flatter delivery, Hales shows his stumps and punches it through wide mid off. The mid off fielder chases it but half-stops it. Hales thinks of a second but Root isn't interested.
Slanting into the batsman, played to long on for a single.
Served outside off, spinning away, defended with the turn on the off side.
Full on middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.
Served on off, Root gets to the pitch and flicks it past short mid-wicket. The long on fielder, hares to his right and makes a stop. A single is taken.
Root plays with soft hands, places it behind point and takes a quick single.
A touch ahead of a length outside off, Root covers the stumps and dabs it to point.
Length delivery, angling in, tucked through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary! Slower delivery outside off, Hales cuts it through point for a boundary. Hales is slowly growing into confidence now.
Length delivery around middle, straightening a touch. Hales looks to play it across the line but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Fuller length delivery on middle and off, Hales flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on the pads, worked to short mid-wicket.
Another quicker one on middle this time, milked down to long on for a single.
Quicker through the air around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery, punched off the back foot down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Creamed! Full outside off, Root takes a good stride forward and gently drives it through the gap in covers for a boundary. That's Root for you!
Sliding in, Root goes back and punches it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed in the backward point region.
Full in the line of the stumps, flicked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Root shuffles across and keeps it out.
Joe Root is the next man in at No.3.

OUT! Beauty in the field by the Fizz! Bangladesh strike through their skipper! Roy the victim. Mortaza bowls a cutter around off, Roy kneels down and across and looks to scoop it over short fine leg. Mustafizur there, jumps full stretch to his right, gets both his hands to it and completes a sensational catch. Roy's poor run continues. Just the start Bangladesh would have wanted.
Angling into the batsman, tucked to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery, nipping away, Roy punches it uppishly but is lucky that it lands safely in front of covers.
Once again it's around off, Hales drives it nicely but straight to the bowler.
Served fuller around off, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! Sliced away! Full outside off, Hales looks to go after the bowler. Tries to go inside out but ends up carving it over covers. Mortaza tries chasing it down but as the ball lands, it travels quickly to the fence.
Slanting into the batsman, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Served fuller outside off, pushed to extra cover.
Sliding into the batsman, defended solidly by prodding forward.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl from the other end with the second new ball. He has a slip in place as well.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Hales gets on his toes and tucks it square of the wicket on the leg side to get off the mark with a single as well.
Another delivery on a length outside off, Roy gets forward a touch and flicks it uppishly through square leg for a single.
Length delivery around off, Roy looks to defend it with a straight bat but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Pitched on a fuller length, shaping away. Roy gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it neatly.
On a length and angling down leg, Roy looks to flick it fine down the leg side but misses. The ball brushes the pads and goes to the keeper.
Length delivery on off, defended back to the bowler.

We are back for the chase. It will be Jason Roy and Alex Hales to open the batting for England. They have a competitive target to try and chase down. Mashrafe Mortaza to open the bowling for his team. He has a slip in place. Let's go...
